topics.label: Rural business start-up and development
topics.description:
Marked operation type 2.7; other governing conditions are outside this row.

Published application closing date: 31 December 2028, under section four of the LEADER call resolution dated 13 April 2026 (BOJA 76, 22 April 2026). Operation 2.7 is selected for AL20. Awards depend on remaining budget; strategy amendments can temporarily suspend submissions. The official deadline was rechecked on 11 November 2026, but the AL20 website timed out, so current local suspensions, later amendments and remaining budget are unconfirmed. The published date does not guarantee that an application can currently be submitted or funded.

funding_reviews.availability_note: Published application closing date: 31 December 2028 (section four of the official LEADER call, 13 April 2026; published 22 April 2026). The deadline was rechecked on 11 November 2026. Awards are budget-limited and strategy amendments may suspend submissions. AL20’s current local status could not be confirmed because its website timed out; the retained open-at-last-check status is dated 10 November 2026.
funding_reviews.territory: AL20; proposed Alhama location is within the documented local territory. Actual site and activity rights are unconfirmed.
funding_reviews.applicants: New self-employed person meeting unemployment, prior-activity, residency and exclusive-dedication requirements
funding_reviews.activities: Operation 2.7 — Rural business start-up and development. See the cited operation’s requirements and exclusions.
funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Start-up instalment available
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. Operation 2.7 permits a first EUR 18,500 instalment when business-plan implementation begins (tax registration), after award notification where applicable. Final EUR 18,500 and any permitted supplements depend on completion and the income/other conditions. This is a business-plan lump sum, not reimbursement of equipment invoices or the full grant upfront.

Business-plan lump sum €37,000, with specified €13,000 additions up to €50,000. First €18,500 payment can be requested when implementation begins, subject to the stated conditions; later payments depend on objectives. No expense reimbursement calculation applies to this operation.

deadlines.label: Published application closing date
deadlines.note: BOJA 76 of 22 April 2026, section four. No exact cutoff/timezone was established. Remaining budget, subsequent amendments and any current local suspension remain unverified.

funding_reviews.verification_note: The official 31 December 2028 deadline is verified against the registered call, PDF position 4; budget limits and amendment-related suspension provisions are at positions 5–6. The AL20 website timed out on 11 November 2026. Retry https://alpujarraalmeria.es/lineas-de-ayuda-23-27/ and check the Junta’s current AL20 strategy/call notices for remaining budget, amendments and any temporary suspension. Preserve the published deadline and last-confirmed local status until those checks succeed. Applicant eligibility remains unconfirmed.
